audience: Art lovers and museum visitors: searches for art, paintings, museum and famous painters; art and culture interests in Apple Ads, museum newsletters and art communities.
story: The paintings first: a Monet coming back into colour, the art packs by painter, then the daily picture, the four shapes, giant boards and the dark finale.
promotionalText: Paintings by Monet, Van Gogh, Hiroshige and more. Swap cards until the masterpiece is whole, at your own pace. Every picture names its author and licence.
deepLinkNote: Impressionists is one of the six free starter packs, so a new player can play it at once.

slides.note: The hook: Monet's chrysanthemums with Painting on, a loose and a locked card lifted.
